vehicles.description: Executive specification vehicle with comprehensive warranty and concierge readiness.

vehicles.name: Porsche Panamera
vehicles.description: Executive specification vehicle with comprehensive warranty and concierge readiness.

vehicles.name: Audi A6 Prestige S-Line
vehicles.description: The Audi A6 Prestige blends sculpted elegance with advanced mild-hybrid performance. Whisper-quiet cruising on the Southern Expressway and Colombo city poise make it ideal for executive meetings and luxury airport transfers.

vehicles.name: BMW 5 Series 530e M Sport
vehicles.description: Sporting agility meets corporate sophistication. The BMW 530e plug-in hybrid delivers effortless torque, premium leather upholstery, and pristine highway dynamics for business professionals.

vehicles.name: Toyota Camry Hybrid Premium Executive
vehicles.description: Supreme reliability combined with executive rear seat comfort. Ideal for comfortable long-distance travel across Sri Lanka with exceptional fuel economy.

vehicles.name: Range Rover Velar P380 R-Dynamic
vehicles.description: Flush deployable handles and undeniable presence. The Velar provides peerless hill-country all-weather stability for trips to Nuwara Eliya, Kandy, or coastal tours along the Galle highway.

vehicles.name: Toyota Land Cruiser Prado TX-L 4WD
vehicles.description: The undisputed king of Sri Lankan terrain. Effortlessly handles steep hill passes, wildlife safaris in Yala or Wilpattu, and executive convoys in pristine comfort.

vehicles.name: BMW X5 xDrive40i M Sport 7-Seater
vehicles.description: Commanding luxury and sports agility. Accommodates up to 7 passengers with supreme comfort, high highway cruising speed, and intuitive digital amenities.

vehicles.name: Aston Martin DBS Superleggera GT
vehicles.description: The pinnacle of Grand Touring. Clad in lightweight carbon composite, the DBS delivers breathless acceleration, symphonic exhaust acoustics, and magnetic presence for high-end weddings and VIP hospitality across Sri Lanka.

vehicles.name: Mercedes-Benz S-Class 580 4MATIC
vehicles.description: The benchmark of luxury chauffeur driving in Sri Lanka. Effortless airmatic glide suspension, hot-stone massage chairs, and whisper-quiet cabin for diplomatic and executive travel.

vehicles.name: Porsche Panamera 4 E-Hybrid Executive
vehicles.description: Combining iconic Porsche sports car DNA with four-door limousine luxury. Exceptional ride comfort, striking road stance, and seamless plug-in hybrid response.

vehicles.name: Mercedes-Benz V-Class Avantgarde VIP
vehicles.description: The gold standard of executive tourism in Sri Lanka. 8 sumptuous leather seats, conference layout, dual AC zones, and ample luggage space for island round-trips and corporate delegations.

vehicles.name: Toyota HiAce Super GL Commuter Luxury
vehicles.description: Sri Lanka’s most trusted long-distance passenger van. Roomy 10-seater configuration with whisper-quiet diesel engine, ice-cold dual AC, and maximum touring reliability from Colombo to Sigiriya, Ella, and Yala.

vehicles.name: Mercedes-Benz Sprinter Executive Shuttle
vehicles.description: Spacious high-roof executive shuttle for airline crews, destination weddings, and large travel groups. Stand-up headroom, individual airflow vents, and smooth Mercedes road manner.

vehicles.name: Ford Transit Custom Tourneo Titanium
vehicles.description: Modern, highly versatile passenger van built for hill-country touring and family getaways. Features flexible seating arrangements and smooth EcoBlue turbo diesel performance.

vehicles.name: Hyundai i20 Premium Hatchback
vehicles.description: Compact, agile, and fuel-efficient. Perfect for navigating Colombo and Kandy city traffic with hassle-free parking, cold AC, and low fuel consumption.

vehicles.name: Suzuki Swift GLX Dualjet Automatic
vehicles.description: Sri Lanka’s favorite nimble city runner. Easy steering, excellent fuel economy, and zippy acceleration for urban commuting and coastal drives.

vehicles.name: Toyota Aqua Hybrid Smart Drive
vehicles.description: Ultra-fuel-efficient hybrid technology. Whisper quiet at low speeds in city congestion, with world-renowned Toyota durability for cost-effective island tours.
